metadata.title: What is PM JANMAN programme for Adivasis | प्रधानमंत्री जनमन के आदिवासियों के लिए क्या मायने हैं
metadata.description:
Further, on November 15, 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Ulihatu Village, the birthplace of  Birsa Munda. Here the Prime Minister launched the Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANAM), with a budget of around Rs 24,000 crore for the overall development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). The Mission will be implemented through the convergence of 11 interventions of 9 Ministries.

There are 75 PVTGs across 18 States & UTs who are living in 22,544 villages (220 districts) with a population of around 28 lakhs. These tribes stay in scattered, remote & inaccessible habitations, often in forest areas and hence a mission is planned to saturate PVTG families and habitations with basic facilities such as road and telecom connectivity, electricity, safe housing, clean drinking water and sanitation, improved access to education, health and nutrition and sustainable livelihood opportunities.
